title: Reconstruct Williams's NEXP not in ACC^0 polynomial method and quantify the exact ACC^0 -> TC^0 degree wall
summary: Reconstructed & verified Williams's ACC^0-SAT engine (Beigel-Tarui R_ell SYM o AND compilation, O(n*2^n) Fast Zeta batch evaluation, l-variable OR-compression) and quantified the exact ACC^0 -> TC^0 wall: MAJ_w requires field-universal probabilistic degree Theta(sqrt(w * log(1/eps))), crossing the rectangular-MM entropy limit H(D/n) = alpha/2 at D/n = 0.0228 (alpha=0.31389) and saturating degree n at depth-2 MAJ o MAJ or quadratic fan-in w = n^2.
